freePlan.limits: 300K tokens/day, 1M tokens/month, public/private projects, 10MB file uploads, website hosting with Bolt branding.

keyLimits.en: No daily token limit; 10M tokens/month included, unused tokens roll over one additional month; removes Bolt branding, custom domains, SEO tools, 100MB file uploads.
Everything in Pro plus team collaboration, centralized billing and admin controls, private NPM registry support.
SSO, audit logs, dedicated account manager, 24/7 priority support, custom SLAs.

cautions.en: Usage is metered in tokens rather than a flat seat price; most token consumption comes from syncing the project's file system to the AI, so token needs scale with project size, not just feature use.

capabilities.en: AI-powered full-stack web app generator: describes an app in natural language and generates executable, deployable code (React frontend, Node.js backend) directly in the browser.
Includes hosting, custom domains, SEO tooling and analytics, plus unlimited databases and enterprise-grade backend infrastructure with authentication and user management.
Requires no local development environment setup; runs entirely in-browser via StackBlitz's WebContainers technology.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 300K tokens/day and 1M tokens/month, and displays Bolt branding on published sites.
File upload size is capped at 10MB on the free plan and 100MB on Pro, limiting large-asset projects.

reason.en: Direct AI app-generation competitor building full-stack web apps from natural-language prompts.
AI-assisted coding tool for building apps, though oriented more toward an IDE workflow than in-browser generation.
AI app builder targeting the same no-setup, prompt-to-app workflow.
AI full-stack app generator competing for the same rapid-prototyping use case.

unknowns: Whether Pro and Teams plans offer an annual discount (annualPerMonth) was not shown on the pricing page; only monthly prices were listed.
